author: Vladyslav Bezsmertnyi
text:
Wired car request slideover across all available-type car card surfaces via VehiclesCarousel.vue.

Decision notes:
- SideWrap (model page) intentionally left as-is — per design, CTA scrolls to the available vehicles section rather than opening the slideover. May be revisited in a future iteration.
- AvailableSideWrap (available single page) was already correctly wired — no changes needed.
- The carousel's handleCtaClick alert stub was replaced with useCarRequestSlideover().open(), passing vehicleId and availableVehicleId with direct: true.
- Used @click.prevent.stop on the CTA button because the card is wrapped in a NuxtLink — .prevent alone was not enough to stop the router navigation; .stop was required to prevent event bubbling to the link.
- The fix covers all three surfaces using VehiclesCarouselSection with type='available': homepage Latest section, model single page, and available single page related cars.
